summary.prose: This Story adds ReviewTargets -- the submitter-owned list naming exactly the content to review this round, rebuilt fresh every round with no builder, factory or merge function of any kind. The build is two Tasks: land the one-field type, then write the full named test suite proving both its exactness (no carry-forward capability) and its structural compatibility with Story s1's path-validation contract.

tasks.title: Add ReviewTargets type
tasks.summary: Add interface ReviewTargets { readonly entries: readonly Pointer[] } to src/workflow/artifact-core/types.ts, beside Scope and Pointer. Exactly sc4's interfaceSketch, with zero additional API surface (no builder, factory, merge function, or validator) per the approved alternative a1.
acceptanceChecks: ReviewTargets is exported from types.ts with exactly sc4's interfaceSketch field shape (readonly entries: readonly Pointer[])
No builder, factory, merge, or validator function for ReviewTargets exists anywhere in types.ts
tsc --noEmit passes with the new type in place

tests.name: ReviewTargets is exported with the exact documented field shape

tasks.title: Write unit and contract tests for ReviewTargets
tasks.summary: Add a flat kebab-case *.test.ts file under src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/ covering: exact-entries construction, independence across rounds, the deliberate absence of any merge/builder/validator function, empty/duplicate/mixed-section entries, and structural compatibility with sc6's PointerPathValidator -- one test case per testStrategy.testLevels subject, matching ac1/ac2's acceptanceMapping verbatim.
acceptanceChecks: Every subject named in the LLD's testStrategy.testLevels has a corresponding test case
ac1 and ac2's provingTests from the LLD's acceptanceMapping all pass
npx tsx --test for the new test file passes with zero failures

tests.name: a ReviewTargets built from a fresh Pointer list contains exactly those entries, nothing else
no builder, factory or merge function exists anywhere in ReviewTargets' exported surface (a1's deliberate absence of such an API)
two ReviewTargets instances built for consecutive rounds on the same artifact are independent objects sharing no entries by construction
ReviewTargets' exported surface contains no validator, allow-list or restriction function of any kind that could cap investigation to entries
a ReviewTargets with zero entries is structurally valid
entries with a duplicate Pointer (same path and section) is accepted
entries mixing whole-file Pointers (no section) and region-pinned Pointers (section populated) is accepted
every ReviewTargets.entries[] Pointer can be passed directly to sc6's PointerPathValidator with no reshaping
